title: Bittensor Daily News — October 30, 2026
summary: Desearch adds company search; TPN introduces quant validation; Nepher opens a robotics challenge. Also: REAX incentive plans, Attune Level 3, Cascade code changes, Beam integrations, Ditto updates and finalized SN59/SN16/SN8 carry-forwards.

ecosystem.headline: TAO Templar replay is available; Leadpoet remains November 5
ecosystem.summary: The October29 Travis / TAO Templar conversation is now a public replay with chapters and guest links. Gavin’s Leadpoet livestream remains November5 at11AMET/8AMPT. The October28 members video is still the latest member upload; completed replays and upcoming streams are listed separately.

updates.headline: SN8 Vanta records a finalized 170.301197993-alpha burn
updates.summary: Successful AlphaBurned at block9392751, extrinsic11, event171 on October29 23:30UTC destroyed exactly170301197993 raw units. This meets the 100-alpha per-event minimum. The burning wallet differs from the current owner coldkey; all-wallet subnet burns and owner-only burns are different scopes. Execution does not by itself prove the source of offchain revenue.
updates.ratingReason: Exact native-token transaction evidence, not an inferred revenue claim.

Earlier monthly burn aggregates remain in yesterday’s report rather than being counted twice.
updates.ratingReason: A dated public operating claim with accounting scope explicit.

updates.headline: SN14 Cacheon: finalized 4,614.416800000 alpha burn

updates.headline: SN16 EG registration ends; a new registration occupies the slot

Its allocation reset to the default vector is lifecycle cleanup, not an owner-set allocation transaction. Prior EG stories remain attached to their historical registration. The chain does not identify an offchain buyer or establish a negotiated sale price.

updates.headline: SN18 Zeus reports 25,000 forecast-archive downloads

Downloads measure archive retrieval, not unique customers, revenue or forecast accuracy. The hashing and download aggregate were not independently reconstructed in this run.

updates.headline: SN19 Blockmachine emphasizes performance-weighted traffic
updates.summary: The October 30 original says speed and reliability now determine node traffic and earnings in its incentive mechanism. This signals the operational goal beyond low list prices. Actual traffic allocation, latency improvements and customer retention were not independently measured.
updates.ratingReason: A concrete mechanism announcement with measured outcomes left unverified.

updates.headline: SN22 Desearch announces Company Search

This adds a company-research route rather than evidence of new customers.
updates.ratingReason: A concrete product capability with an explicit documentation access gap.

updates.headline: SN58 Attune raises generalization tests with Level 3
updates.summary: Robotensor’s October 29 original says Level 3 changes object models and categories, sizes and colors while varying scene conditions. Its clip explicitly labels Level 3 live. The team reports Level 2 ended at 92.5% after 125 duels; these are its simulation-competition results, not independently measured physical-robot adoption. The harder task aims to distinguish generalization from memorizing one object.
updates.ratingReason: A concrete competition update with team-reported metrics bounded.

updates.headline: SN59 owner share rises to 31.9696% in a finalized allocation
updates.summary: At finalized block 9391035 on October 29 17:46:48 UTC, owner allocation changed 30.1% to 31.9696%, validators 36.9% to 35.0304%, miners stayed 33%; TAO and recycle slots remained zero. Extrinsic 18/event197 executed successfully. Exact five-slot vectors and registration8938771 are retained in permanent evidence. Root baseline is paid first and capped by validator allocation; displayed yield history can lag. This is not a transaction burn.

updates.headline: SN65 TPN introduces quantized-model validation
updates.summary: October 30 TPN announces a workbench tool comparing a quantized model with its parent using next-token agreement, KL divergence and perplexity. The public workbench describes validation tied to exact weights and a quote-before-run workflow. This can help developers assess a compression tradeoff; no paid job was run and the reported measures are not a universal proof of equal downstream quality.
updates.ratingReason: A usable developer-tool announcement; independent execution and output verification remain untested.

updates.headline: SN91 Cascade merges per-round eligibility code
updates.summary: GitHub PRs 382 and 383 merged October 29. Trainer code replaces lifetime hotkey submission exclusion with per-settlement-round eligibility; documentation separates CPU generation from the GPU training clock and requires 32-channel generators. The PR explicitly says the rule applies on trainer restart. A merge and a scheduled launch target do not verify production activation; larger GPU layouts remain planned.
updates.ratingReason: Verified code and documentation changes, not a claimed live activation.

updates.headline: SN92 REAX schedules demand-linked inference and competition rewards
updates.summary: The official FAQ, updated October 29, marks the new policy approved from the first weight set after the October 30 14:30 UTC engine slot. Inference is planned to move from 50% to 40% of miner emissions. Competition champions retain full payment for three days, followed during a pause by decay to day seven and keep-alive treatment. Unused allocations are intended to be burned. These are miner-emission policy plans, not a verified eTAO-vector change or qualifying transaction burn; execution at the scheduled boundary was not established by this review.
updates.ratingReason: Material miner rules with effective-time and denominator separated from chain execution.

updates.headline: SN105 Beam reports Hugging Face and Zapier connectors

This offers routes for moving datasets and model weights into existing workflows. No authenticated transfer or Zapier partner-directory verification was performed. Platform-wide Hugging Face catalog sizes are not Beam customer counts, and this is one integration story rather than separate repeated launches.
updates.ratingReason: Concrete integration announcements with testing and partner-verification limits.
